archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-routing
archetypes.rationale: Completion evidence moved from guard-era sentinels to bgjob result envs across design and implement steps.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed design and implement routing code plus shell wrappers for stale sentinel assumptions. Focus on whether every long-step completion path now gates on the correct bgjob result env and required KVs without dropping distinct non-guard milestones. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
